title: MCP (Model Context Protocol): how agents reach tools, and where you can stop them
summary: The data-policy PowerShell example creates a policy but does not choose which connectors to allow or block. Replace it with the documented connector-classification operation before administrators rely on the automation column. The cited pages were accessible in this check, including those previously rate-limited.
